# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 065

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1600–1624, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. All 25 Hindi entries were semantically understandable, but their examples contained unnecessary English fragments or awkward literal phrasing. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi while preserving the intended meaning for study.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 1,625/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (18.39%); 7,212 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
